resources.string: Bought a unit? Scan the hidden code under its scratch-off to mark it as used. No account and no fees.
This can\'t be undone. Once recorded, anyone verifying this unit will see it as already used, so a refilled copy is exposed.
You verified batch #%1$s · unit #%2$d. Scan the hidden code of that same package.
Revealed by scratching the seal on the package
This hidden code belongs to a different unit than the one you verified. Don\'t record use for a package you didn\'t buy.
How this stays private and free
Your phone signs the request with the unit\'s one-time key and an anonymous address created on this device. A relayer pays the blockchain fee; the secret never leaves your phone.
Batch #%1$s · unit #%2$d is now recorded as used. Any refill will be detected.
